intent: Allow users to source generated zsh completions dynamically without invoking completion-only commands during ordinary sourcing, while preserving completion registration and behavior.

findings.title: Sourcing before compinit still runs completion code
findings.suggested_fix: Do not call _rg during ordinary top-level sourcing just because compdef is unavailable; reserve that path for the completion test mode, or document and enforce that dynamic sourcing occurs after compinit.
findings.why_it_matters: If a user follows the FAQ example before compinit defines compdef, sourcing takes this branch and calls _rg. _rg then reaches _arguments, which is completion-only, so the documented source command still fails during shell startup. Only running the dynamic source after completion initialization avoids this path.
